first_impression.reaction: Googled 'wedding morning timeline' on the train. The first paragraph actually answers it: work back from the ceremony, and for 4pm that's 9am or 10am. Good, I got my answer in about ten seconds. What I really want now is the full list of times to screenshot, and that's a long scroll down. Bookmarking for the sample timeline and the template, not enquiring.

journey.quote: For a 4pm ceremony, for example, that can mean hair and makeup from 9am with a first look or from 10am without one.
journey.reaction: An actual time, straight away. This is why I clicked.

journey.quote: The number of people in the chairs, and the pace your stylist and artist give you at the trial, set the start time.
journey.reaction: Fair, but none of the takeaways have a time in them. If I only read this box I'd leave without the 9am/10am bit.

journey.section: How a wedding morning timeline works
journey.quote: The start of the first chair is the last number you work out, not the first.
journey.reaction: Oh, that clicks. Simple numbered list, easy on a phone.

journey.section: The order of the hair and makeup chairs
journey.quote: Some teams prefer them second to last, so that if the morning runs over, a member of the wedding party waits rather than the couple.
journey.reaction: Didn't know that one. Useful tip, sending to my maid of honour.

journey.section: How long bridal hair and makeup takes
journey.quote: There is no single honest figure to plan around.
journey.reaction: The heading promised me how long it takes and then didn't tell me. I get why, but it feels like a dodge. At least point me to the example times so I have something to go on.

journey.section: A sample wedding morning timeline for a 4pm ceremony
journey.reaction: This is the screenshot. Clear times, short lines. But I had to scroll past seven sections to find it.

journey.section: When the ceremony is in the morning
journey.quote: Move the ceremony to 11am with the same people and team, and that chair moves to 4.30am.
journey.reaction: Ha, okay, that's a very clear reason not to do 11am. Memorable.

journey.section: A wedding morning schedule template to copy
journey.quote: Copy this into a document or spreadsheet and fill it from the bottom up, starting with the ceremony.
journey.reaction: Nice to have, though copying a five-column table on a phone is fiddly. I'll do it on my laptop later.

journey.quote: ### What time should hair and makeup start for a 4pm ceremony?
journey.reaction: Exactly the question I'd type, and a short direct answer. Good FAQ overall.

journey.section: Plan the morning with one person
journey.quote: If you would like to plan it with someone, a Wedded Advisor works in your time zone, agrees the fee in writing before any work begins, and confirms inclusions in writing before you commit.
journey.reaction: I came for a timeline, not a planner. 'Agrees the fee' makes me wonder what the fee is. Not for me right now.
